profile.reading: This Csquare facility is in the Santa Clara/Sunnyvale, California area, part of the Silicon Valley market. Csquare, the same operator recorded elsewhere in this registry under the name Centersquare (centersquaredc.com redirects to csquare.com), states on its own site that it runs 80 colocation data centers across 30 markets, totaling 3.5 million square feet of space and more than 500 megawatts of power capacity, serving over 2,000 customers, and describes having operated for over 20 years. The company is headquartered at 3100 Olympus Boulevard, Suite 510, Coppell, Texas. No detailed founding history, prior company names, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular row were confirmed in available sourcing this session.
